categories_description: Every entry can belong to several categories, which group what the corpus documents by theme.
categories_empty_description: No category has been created yet.
categories_manage_delete_dialog_message: Entries using it will be detached, no entry will be deleted.
categories_manage_description: Renaming a category moves the concerned entries to the new address. Deleting it detaches them without erasing them.
categories_manage_field_slug_taken: This address is already in use.
categories_slug_empty_description: No entry belongs to this category yet.
categories_slug_unknown_description: No category goes by this name.
common_empty_wiki_description: This wiki is empty: start by creating the first entry.
connection_status_failure_conflict: The online backup changed on another device. It is up to you to choose what to keep.
connection_status_failure_missing: Automatic sending failed: no backup on this server.
connection_status_failure_network: Automatic sending failed: the server is not responding.
connection_status_failure_refused: Automatic sending refused: the server's password has changed.
connection_status_failure_server: Automatic sending failed: the server ran into an error.
connection_status_failure_unreadable: Automatic sending failed: the server's response could not be understood.
connection_status_failure_unsupported: Automatic sending failed: this address no longer leads to a backup server.
connection_status_offline_pending: Offline. Your changes will go out as soon as the connection returns.
dashboard_activity_description: Number of entries edited per month, over a year.
dashboard_description: The state of the corpus, computed from what the site currently shows, local changes included.
dashboard_issues_empty: Nothing to report on the corpus.
dashboard_missing_empty: No red link, everything cited exists.
data_clear_description: Deletes all your pages from this device, at once and with no way back. Make a copy first, unless you really want to start from zero.
data_description: What you write stays on this device, and nowhere else. Nobody else sees it, but nothing protects it either: clear the browser's data, or change computer, and it is all gone. Make a copy, in a file you keep, or online to find your wiki again from another device.
data_reset_dialog_message: All your pages will be deleted from this device. Whatever has not been copied elsewhere will be lost.
data_reset_feedback: Your wiki has been cleared from this device.
edit_empty_description: It may have been deleted, or its address may have changed.
entry_form_aliases_hint: Taken into account by search, without creating a page.
entry_form_dates_hint: One date per landmark: birth and death, founding, occurrence. Each one places the page on the timeline and shows in the infobox. « 2043-06-12 », « June 2043 » or « The third winter » are all accepted.
entry_form_delete_confirm_message: The page will be permanently deleted.
entry_form_slug_taken_hint: Another page already uses this address. A number will be appended.
entry_form_summary_placeholder: One or two sentences. They appear below the title, in listings and in search.
entry_form_title_placeholder: Name of the character, place, event...
entry_form_unsaved_confirm: Some changes have not been saved. Leave the editor anyway?
entry_image_fields_hint: Paste the address of an image online. If you have access to the site's files, drop it in the media folder and give its path.
entry_picker_hint: Search for an existing page, or type a new title to place a red link.
entry_picker_input_label: Title of the page to link
error_fallback_message: The requested path does not match any known entry.
error_heading_not_found: This page is not in the archives
featured_pages_description: The first one takes the large card on the home page, the next two the side cards.
file_backup_copy_error: Your browser refused the copy. Use the download instead, it gives the same file.
file_backup_copy_success: Backup copied. Paste it wherever you want to keep it.
file_backup_download_description: The file contains everything you see on the site, drafts included. Downloading it changes nothing in your wiki: it is a copy, not a move.
file_backup_download_success: Backup downloaded. Your wiki has not changed.
file_backup_file_ready: {name} is ready. Run the restore to replace your pages with those in the file.
file_backup_import_error: This content is not a valid backup. Your wiki was not changed.
file_backup_intro: Your whole wiki in a single file, downloaded onto this device. Nothing leaves for the internet. Keep this file safe: it will give you back your pages, here or on another computer.
file_backup_paste_label: Or paste the content of a backup
file_backup_paste_placeholder: Paste the content of a backup file here.
file_backup_replace_message: Your current pages will be replaced with those from the backup. Anything not copied elsewhere will be lost.
file_backup_restore_description: To resume a backup, or recover work done on another device. Careful, the replacement is total: the site will show exactly what the file contains, and your current pages will disappear. Download a copy first if you have work in progress.
file_backup_restored_summary: Backup restored: {entries}, {categories}, and {live} in the feed.
live_composer_body_placeholder: One or two sentences. Markdown accepted.
live_composer_pin_checkbox: Pin at the top of the feed
live_delete_dialog_message: The entry will be permanently deleted.
live_empty_description: No feed entry matches this filter.
live_how_it_works_p1: A feed entry is short and timestamped. When an event deserves more, link it to an entry: the « Read the full entry » link appears under the item.
live_how_it_works_p2: An item at « Alert » severity shows a banner across the whole site for twenty four hours.
live_latest_prefix: The latest one dates back to
live_meta_description: Feed of the events under way in {universe}.
live_storage_description: Every publication is written straight into this browser's local storage: it appears here immediately, but stays specific to this device until it has been exported.
local_content_empty_intro: Nothing is stored on this device yet.
local_content_empty_outro: to get started, or restore a backup below.
local_content_identity_intro: Name, signature, description, logo or featured pages set from
local_content_storage_warning: The space available on this device is nearly exhausted. Make a copy of your wiki, then clear it to start fresh.
markdown_editor_placeholder: Write the page. Type / to insert a block.
markdown_missing_page_title: This page does not exist yet
remote_backup_autopush_hint_never_synced: Turn on after a first manual synchronisation: without that, the first automatic send would overwrite a backup you have never seen.
remote_backup_autopush_hint_synced: Your changes go out on their own a few seconds after the last keystroke, and wait while you are offline. A send refused because the online backup changed is never forced: you are notified and you decide here.
remote_backup_autopush_label: Send automatically when the connection returns
remote_backup_conditional_note: This server tracks its revisions, so a send is refused if the backup has changed since your last read.
remote_backup_directions_note: Both directions replace everything: sending overwrites the server's backup with your pages, restoring overwrites your pages with the backup.
remote_backup_failure_conflict: The online backup has changed since your last read, likely from another device.
remote_backup_failure_missing: This server does not contain any backup yet.
remote_backup_failure_network: The server is not responding. Check the address, and that it is online.
remote_backup_failure_server: The server ran into an error on its side. Try again later.
remote_backup_failure_unreadable: The server's response could not be understood. It may not be a backup server.
remote_backup_failure_unsupported: This address does not lead to a backup server. Check it with whoever installed it.
remote_backup_forget_confirm_message: You will need to re enter the address and password to reconnect to this server. Your pages are not affected by this operation.
remote_backup_forgotten: Server forgotten. Your wiki keeps working on this device.
remote_backup_intro: Optional, and unnecessary for most uses: the wiki works perfectly well with just the file backup above. Setting a server lets you find your pages on another device without passing a file by hand. As long as this field stays empty, nothing leaves this device. You need a server of your own, one that someone had to install for the occasion.
remote_backup_overwrite_confirm_message: Changes made on the server since your last read will be permanently lost.
remote_backup_restore_confirm_message: Your pages will be replaced with those from the backup. Anything you have not sent will be lost.
remote_backup_restored_summary: Wiki restored: {entries}, {categories}, and {live} in the feed.
remote_backup_secret_hint: It is kept as is on this device, and encrypts nothing: it only stops a stranger from writing to your server. Do not use a password you rely on elsewhere.
remote_backup_secret_placeholder: Leave empty if the server does not ask for one
remote_backup_send_confirm_message: Your pages will completely replace the server's backup.
remote_backup_send_confirm_message_empty: Your wiki is empty. The send will therefore replace the server's backup with an empty wiki.
remote_backup_storage_error_suffix: The server stays usable, but it will be forgotten when leaving this page.
remote_backup_sync_stale: You have written since the last synchronisation. Send to update the backup, or restore to abandon what you have written since.
remote_backup_sync_synced: Online backup up to date: it holds exactly your current pages.
remote_backup_sync_unknown: You have never synchronised this device with this server yet.
remote_backup_test_empty: Connection successful. This server does not contain any backup yet.
remote_backup_test_success: Connection successful. The online backup contains {count}.
remote_backup_unconditional_note: This server does not track its revisions, so the last send overwrites the previous one without warning.
remote_backup_unsaved_url: Address not saved, testing will save it
remote_backup_url_hint: The address given to you by whoever installed the server, exactly as is.
remote_config_write_error: Could not save the server configuration: {error}
search_dialog_placeholder: Search a character, a place, an event...
settings_description: The name of your universe and how it presents itself. These fields appear in the header, on the home page, and whenever someone shares a link to your wiki.
settings_form_accent_hint: It colors article links, buttons and the header logo.
settings_form_description_placeholder: A few words about your universe, shown when a link is shared.
settings_form_language_hint: Changes what every page of the site is written in. The page reloads to apply it.
settings_form_logo_hint: The address of an image, online or in the site's files. Leave empty to keep the initial.
settings_form_reset_confirm_message: The name, description, logo and featured pages will go back to their original state.
settings_form_saved_intro: Saved. Remember to make a copy from
timeline_description_end: . An entry comes back at each of its dates, and those carrying none do not appear here.
timeline_empty_description: Add a reference date to an entry to see it appear here.
timeline_meta_description: The dated events of {universe}, in order.
wiki_description_filter_hint: Filter by category, by status or by keyword.
wiki_no_match_description: Broaden or reset the filters to find the corpus again.
wiki_slug_backlinks_empty: No entry points to this slug.
wiki_slug_unwritten_description: The link that leads here is waiting for a page. That is the point of a red link: it signals a gap to fill.
wiki_slug_unwritten_title: This entry does not exist yet
wiki_storage_write_error: Could not save the local changes, the browser storage is full. Export the JSON to avoid losing anything. ({error})
